g.text: A run is not a transaction: the card is declined, the Payment agent says so, and the flight and hotel stay booked.
Seat and room stay reserved, unpaid.
Believe the system is monolithic, and:
· the steps are written as one unit, whole or nothing
· no step comes with a way to undo it
· a failed step leaves the others done
Undos written in advance; a failure is an error.
Fix: a saga that undoes finished steps in reverse;
what can't be undone last; a person if an undo fails.
(3) "B-001 isn't paid: the company card was declined."
The run ends, no error; FL101 and B-001 stay booked.
(1) the runtime records nothing it could undo
(2) the orchestrator improvises the plan, with no undo
(3) the Payment agent turns the decline into a reply
Fix: the runtime records each booking's undo as it
succeeds, and runs them newest first if nothing is paid.
